note: Every example was downloaded and viewed during research; image_urls are references only — no image data stored. Analyses are principle extraction, not templates to copy.

examples.title: PORTER magazine cover
examples.idea: Monochrome star portrait; giant single-letter masthead 'P' acts as logo-glyph; headline stacked bottom-left.
examples.composition: Portrait fills ~85% of frame, figure slightly right of centre; masthead glyph top-left ~30% of width; headline block bottom-left ~45% width.
examples.typography: High-contrast didone-like display (GS Triomf) for masthead and headline, all caps, tight leading (~0.85), tight tracking; tiny Century Schoolbook tagline rotated vertically.
examples.hierarchy: 1 portrait face, 2 'P' glyph, 3 headline; nothing else competes.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Three-quarter body, crop at thigh; face in top third; arms crossed = confident pose; black&white lowers noise.
examples.colour: ~70% mid-greys, ~25% black, ~5% white type; zero accent colour.
examples.grid: Narrow ~5% margins; type overlaps the photo, not boxed.
examples.negative_space: Dark background behind subject is the breathing room; text sits on darker zones for contrast.
examples.metaphor: None literal: 'the other' = mood via B/W.
examples.art_direction: One strong photograph + one display typeface + no decoration.
premium: Only one typeface family carries the whole cover.
Black & white portrait with large type removes every 'template' cue.

examples.title: Swiss Wine. Das Magazin
examples.idea: Huge condensed serif masthead overlapped by a single landscape photo window.
examples.composition: Masthead top 30%, photo window centred 60%×55%, small italic subline + logo below; strong central axis.
examples.typography: Condensed contrast serif (Italian Plate family) in deep red, ~22% of page height; italic serif subline ~2% height.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Landscape photo cropped as rectangle; masthead bottom letters slightly overlap into photo (depth).
examples.colour: ~55% cream paper, ~35% photo greens/blues, ~10% wine red.
examples.negative_space: Generous cream margins frame the photo like a mat.
premium: Single brand colour (wine red) used only for type.
Cream instead of white gives paper warmth.

examples.title: Vert magazine (Croatian gardening/lifestyle)
examples.idea: Illustrated branch with berries; one blurred-berry layer adds photographic depth to an illustration.
examples.composition: Illustration diagonal from bottom-left to top-right covering ~60%; logo small at right edge; lots of pale space.
examples.typography: Soft serif italic logotype (Rector) placed small, rotated with the composition; tiny metadata in corners.
examples.hierarchy: Image first, logo second — logo deliberately modest.
examples.colour: ~70% pale blush, ~20% red berries, ~10% dark brown branch.
examples.grid: Corner metadata anchors the four corners.
examples.metaphor: Seasonal cycle: a single winter branch = the issue's season.
examples.art_direction: Concept-object on empty field; small type.
premium: Logo is small — confidence instead of shouting.
Single symbolic object rather than a collage.

examples.title: Bibliothèque(s) no.105 'Droits culturels'
examples.idea: Title letters placed in circles connected by arrows — a network diagram that is also the headline.
examples.composition: Masthead condensed black across top; diagram occupies centre 60%.
examples.typography: Ultra-condensed grotesk masthead (Nein); typewriter-like letters in circles (HD Microbic); tiny sans for metadata.
examples.colour: ~75% coral red, ~20% light grey circles, ~5% black.
examples.grid: Free diagram over strict masthead band.
examples.metaphor: Rights as a connected network — the information structure is the visual.
premium: The concept is expressed with type alone — no stock imagery.
Two-colour discipline.

examples.title: Zürich Barock — Opernhaus magazine
examples.idea: Baroque blackletter-like 'Kurrent' meets grotesk; engraved figure illustration; monochrome on turquoise.
examples.composition: Stacked centred title ~45% height, illustration middle, dates bottom.
examples.typography: ES Klarheit Grotesk + ES Klarheit Kurrent (historic script cut) — period-appropriate pairing within one superfamily.
examples.metaphor: Historical style rendered in contemporary type.
premium: Superfamily pairing (grotesk + historic cut) keeps harmony.
Single ink colour on coloured stock.

examples.title: Notes on Plural Intelligence #1 'Together Apart'
examples.idea: Repeated stacked title words bleed off top and bottom; small duotone photos tucked behind words.
examples.composition: Words repeated 6× forming a column; photos as small cards at left/right.
examples.typography: Condensed grotesk caps (Farmacia) ~9% height per line, leading ~0.9; small sans metadata row at top.
examples.hierarchy: Rhythm of repeated title > photo cards > metadata.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Small duotone green photos, cropped as polaroid-like cards.
examples.colour: ~70% sage green, ~25% pale pink type, ~5% white.
examples.grid: 3-column top metadata row; central title column.
premium: Duotone photos unify mixed imagery.
Bleeding type implies continuation beyond the frame.

examples.title: FARM magazine cover (goldfinch)
examples.idea: Animal portrait treated like a human cover star; masthead vertical on spine side.
examples.composition: Bird head fills ~70%, eye on upper third line; vertical masthead left edge; contents list bottom-right.
examples.typography: Bold grotesk masthead rotated 90°; right-aligned bold sans list.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Extreme close-up, cropped at chest; neutral grey backdrop.
examples.art_direction: Studio portrait of a non-human subject.
premium: Gaze contact (the eye) gives cover power.
Vertical masthead frees the full portrait.

examples.title: the Room magazine no.15
examples.idea: Head-only portrait floating on flat pink; patterned cap and collar match.
examples.composition: Head centred, ~55% width; small masthead top; issue number below.
examples.typography: Light sans masthead with italic serif 'm'; tiny small-caps names line.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Cut-out head + collar (body removed) — surreal crop.
premium: Surreal crop done cleanly (no shadow fakery).
Masthead tiny relative to face.

examples.title: Interview (Russian edition) cover
examples.idea: Brush-script masthead overlapping hair; a bee on the lips as visual twist.
examples.composition: Face tight crop, eyes on upper-third line; masthead top across hair; names bottom.
examples.typography: Hand-brushed masthead; small serif names, mixed italic/roman.
examples.art_direction: Single surreal prop on a beauty portrait.
premium: Tight crop with forehead cut = editorial confidence.
One unexpected detail creates the story.

examples.title: AFAR travel magazine cover
examples.idea: POV photo from a canoe; hand at bottom invites the reader in.
examples.composition: Masthead thin wide caps across top; cover line left; contents column top-right.
examples.typography: Ultra-light geometric caps masthead; bold condensed cover lines in yellow.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: First-person perspective; leading lines of boat converge to top.
examples.colour: ~50% dark water, ~35% yellow/blue boat, ~15% white type.
examples.negative_space: Water texture acts as calm field for text.
examples.metaphor: Journey = you are in the boat.
premium: Headline colour sampled from the photo (yellow).
Leading lines guide to masthead.

examples.title: Family Portrait magazine issue 01 (9 covers)
examples.idea: Documentary family photos; logo set on a circle like a stamp; 9 alternative covers.
examples.composition: Photo full-bleed; circular logo top-right ~25% width.
examples.typography: Rounded bold script-like display (Asphalt) bent on a circle.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Documentary flash, candid; people with animals/children.
examples.colour: Photo-driven; logo in coral/green chosen per cover.
examples.grid: Logo position fixed across all covers.
examples.art_direction: Documentary + one fixed graphic device = series.
premium: Fixed logo position + changing photo = instant series.
Candid, un-retouched photos.

examples.title: Good Times podcast — host card
examples.idea: Host cut-out standing in front of a giant first name; surname written in script across.
examples.composition: First name in grey ultra-bold fills ~85% width; person at right overlapping letters; script surname diagonal.
examples.typography: Ultra-bold condensed sans (Affigere) + casual script (Blitz Script) + mono for small info.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Waist-up cut-out, arms crossed, smiling, eye contact.
examples.colour: ~60% saturated blue, ~25% light grey type, ~10% person, ~5% orange script.
premium: Person overlaps type (depth) instead of sitting beside it.
Script used once, as accent only.

examples.title: Herrat 2025 — 'The Glasses' poster
examples.designer: Credited on source page (image caption: Simbayu Studios)
examples.idea: Face cropped from nose up; dollar-smiley sunglasses become the message.
examples.composition: Title top-left ~70% width; face bottom 65%; crop cuts above mouth.
examples.typography: Heavy humanist sans (Gill Kayo) in yellow; small light sans body text 3 lines.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Extreme frontal crop cutting the head top and mouth — focus on the prop.
examples.metaphor: Irony of success shown in an object.
premium: Tight, brave crop.
Complementary blue/yellow with no extra colours.

examples.title: TEC Technical Education Copenhagen — campaign + identity
examples.idea: Real students as cover stars; bold 'FROM X TO Y' headlines; striped T-pattern derived from logo.
examples.composition: Portrait poster: people fill top 75%, headline bottom-left ~45% width, pattern band at bottom.
examples.typography: Custom grotesk (TEC Sans) caps, tight leading ~0.95, wide letter-forms; short 2-line headlines.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Full-body/three-quarter, natural poses, arms crossed, direct gaze; real workshop backgrounds.
examples.colour: ~60% photo neutrals, ~30% black/white pattern, ~10% white type.
examples.grid: Strong left margin ~6%; pattern modules on a square grid.
examples.metaphor: 'From apprentice to master' — progression in words + pattern.
premium: Pattern is built from the logo, so every piece is recognisable.
Headlines are journeys (from→to), not slogans.

examples.title: Primer school — age-group portraits + building-block grid
examples.idea: Child portraits with huge age numbers (K-2, 3-5, 6-8) overlapping the photo; square-grid building blocks.
examples.composition: Portrait centred, number set across chest height ~70% width; billboard: modular grid with photo cells and colour cells.
examples.typography: Bold grotesk numerals in single brand colours; serif-like wordmark 'Primer.' bottom-left.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Seated full-body children on light seamless, natural expression.
examples.colour: ~70% white/light, ~20% photo, ~10% one bright colour per age group.
examples.grid: Visible square module grid (12×4 on billboard).
premium: One colour per series item makes a set read as a system.
Grid cells hold photo, colour or word interchangeably.

examples.title: Onomastics research carousel — slide 1
examples.idea: Black cover slide with elegant thin caps title; names as coloured sticker-tags.
examples.composition: Title centred ~70% width over 4 lines; tags overlapping line ends; subline grey; logo bottom.
examples.typography: Thin high-contrast display caps (Spalla) mixed with one bold line (NOMES); secondary sans (Area) for subline; scale ratio title:sub ≈ 4:1.
examples.hierarchy: Bold word 'NOMES' > rest of title > tags > subline > logo.
premium: One weight change creates the hierarchy — no extra colour needed.
Neon used only for tiny tags.

examples.title: Ralf Lobeck Instagram posts
examples.idea: Huge serif caps over painterly texture, an italic script-like line crossing through.
examples.composition: Stacked 3-line caps ~80% width; italic line crosses at middle in contrasting colour.
examples.typography: Didone-ish serif (BF Rotwang) roman caps + italic lowercase with ligatures; ratio ~3:1.
examples.colour: ~60% red/orange texture, ~30% white type, ~10% black italic.
premium: Roman + italic of the same family = refined contrast.
Background is the artist's own material, not stock.

examples.title: NatWest social media posts
examples.idea: Warm family photo + purple rounded panel with slab-serif headline and one highlighted word.
examples.composition: Photo full-bleed; panel bottom-left ~55% width; or headline top-right over photo.
examples.typography: Slab serif (Jubilat) bold 3-line headline; one word on highlighter strip; sans CTA.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Lifestyle: mother and child high-five; genuine laughter; eye-level.
premium: Highlighter only on the key word (money/Today).
Real emotion in photo.

examples.title: Education Elements — social posts, banners, web
examples.idea: System of coloured tiles: some type-only, some photo, some data bars; short imperative lines ('Make every class count').
examples.composition: Each tile 1 idea: either a big statement or a stat (35%) or a photo with caption.
examples.typography: Condensed bold sans headlines (~3 words/line), sentence case; italic for emphasis; big numerals for stats.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Children/teachers, natural, cropped at chest, often cut out of frames.
examples.colour: Rotating palette: yellow, blue, pink, red, black; each tile ~80% one colour.
examples.grid: Vertical banners use rotated text along long edge.
premium: Data shown as simple bars in brand colours.
Each tile has exactly one message.

examples.title: Kinetik — LinkedIn post and billboard
examples.idea: Painterly meadow background; white card with serif headline, final phrase in italic accent colour.
examples.composition: Card centred ~85% width; text top-left in card; generous empty card space.
examples.typography: Transitional serif, roman + italic in violet for key phrase; sentence case; leading ~1.15.
examples.colour: ~60% muted meadow, ~30% white card, ~10% navy/violet type.
premium: Italic of the same serif as the only accent.
Empty card space = calm.

examples.title: SMK National Gallery of Denmark — story, column, poster
examples.idea: Artwork full-bleed with bold red wordmark and short caps title; type-only poster with giant condensed name + date.
examples.composition: Story: artwork full-bleed, wordmark top-left, title mid-left in 3 lines; poster: 3 lines fill 90% width.
examples.typography: Heavy condensed grotesk caps, leading ~0.9, tracking ~-1%; dates in same weight.
examples.colour: Story: artwork colours + ~5% red; poster: ~70% green, ~30% black.
premium: Type-only poster with just name + date.
Same typographic voice across story, column, poster.

examples.title: Quintus Miller open lecture poster
examples.idea: Facade grid of the architect's buildings rendered as red→navy gradient blocks; elegant italic name.
examples.composition: Upper 45%: name + info; lower 55%: bent facade grid; small text column.
examples.typography: Italic serif (Adobe Caslon) for name ~9% height; small caps sans (Metropolis) for info; ratio ~6:1.
examples.metaphor: Architecture as a grid of windows.
premium: Serif italic person name gives humanity to a technical graphic.
Info set small and orderly.

examples.title: Johannes Schwartz lecture poster (HfG Offenbach)
examples.idea: The speaker's own photograph framed by his name running around the edge like a border.
examples.composition: Photo centred ~75%; name letters run clockwise around frame; info set in Helvetica at right.
examples.typography: Heavy display (Rutor Stone) rotating around frame + Helvetica regular for info.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Still-life by the photographer himself, close crop.
premium: Uses the speaker's own work — authenticity.
Only two typefaces, roles clear.

examples.title: 'YOUTH — Word of Life' annual conference poster (Moscow)
examples.idea: Blue monochrome stage photo inside a red frame; title glyphs customised (Ø, Ŧ).
examples.composition: Red outline frame inset ~5%; title across centre ~75% width; photo block behind title; info centred top and bottom.
examples.typography: Geometric caps title with custom glyphs; small tracked caps (~+100) for info lines.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Concert crowd shot turned to blue duotone.
premium: Duotone unifies a weak stock-like photo.
Tracked small caps info = order.

examples.title: Trey Trahan lecture poster (MIT)
examples.designer: Not shown on page (MIT Architecture lecture series)
examples.idea: Speaker name built from a stencil/constructed display alphabet; everything else tiny.
examples.composition: Name + date fill middle 35%; information blocks at top and bottom in a 3-column grid.
examples.typography: Constructed geometric display ~10% height per line; small serif body ~1.5%.
premium: Extreme scale contrast (display:body ≈ 7:1).
One colour.

examples.title: 'Studio8 Design: Collaborations in Type & Print' talk poster
examples.designer: Not shown on page (The Typographic Circle event)
examples.idea: Two black circles forming an '8' on yellow.
examples.composition: Graphic occupies top 75%; info row bottom 20% in columns.
examples.typography: Bold sans title 3 lines; tiny info columns.
premium: One idea, two shapes.
Info hierarchy at bottom like a colophon.

examples.title: SALA Fall 2013 Lecture Series poster
examples.idea: Geometric pattern of half-circles; lecture dates in large numerals within the pattern.
examples.composition: Pattern full-bleed, 4×4 module; title in one module; dates in modules.
examples.typography: Bold sans title, large numerals for dates.
premium: Dates integrated into the pattern modules.
Three-colour limit.

examples.title: JTBC 'Tomorrow Conference' 2013 poster
examples.idea: Gradient 3D-like ribbon forming abstract letter; Korean text left-aligned column.
examples.composition: Ribbon centre-right ~65%; text column top-left.
examples.typography: Simple sans, left aligned, generous line spacing.
premium: Text kept simple so the form can be loud.
White ground.

examples.title: QWF Literary Awards Gala 2026 (Instagram version)
examples.idea: Flat illustrated objects (open book, notebook, cocktail glasses) on navy with stars; retro serif title.
examples.composition: Title top 25% centred; objects as a still life bottom 70%.
examples.typography: ITC Benguiat caps in gold, 3 lines centred; TT Commons for info.
premium: Objects tell the theme without words.
Limited 4-colour palette.

examples.title: Projektor — Day of Architecture for young people (Hamburg)
examples.idea: A house-shaped coloured block containing the headline; arch shapes hold info.
examples.composition: House shape ~80% of poster; title inside; arches bottom.
examples.typography: Playful grotesk (Rauschen Max) with mixed-case; Bahnschrift for info.
examples.metaphor: Text lives inside a house = architecture for kids.
premium: Container shape is the concept.
Two dominant colours only.

examples.title: Kerning — International Conference on Typography
examples.idea: The 'K' and an arrow form a logo about spacing; type used as the subject.
examples.composition: Mark centred ~55% width; wordmark below.
examples.typography: Heavy geometric sans.
premium: Metaphor drawn from the topic itself.
Flat 3-colour.

examples.title: 'protégez l'enfant!' — Automobile-Club de Suisse
examples.designer: Page does not credit; commonly attributed to Josef Müller-Brockmann (1953)
examples.idea: Huge motorbike wheel vs small running child — scale contrast tells the danger.
examples.composition: Wheel fills ~65% diagonally from top-left; child small bottom-right; yellow road strip bottom.
examples.typography: Simple grotesk, small, top-left; headline only 3 words.
examples.negative_space: White area between wheel and child is the 'danger gap'.
premium: The message is in the scale relationship, not in the text.
Text minimal and functional.

examples.title: Fitbit 'Fit for every you'
examples.idea: A running silhouette filled with multiple life moments (photos); stacked yellow headline over it.
examples.composition: Silhouette cut-out fills ~75%; headline 4 lines centred ~60% width.
examples.typography: Condensed bold sans, all caps, yellow, leading ~1.0; small tracked caps subline.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Multiple photos clipped inside a body silhouette.
premium: Collage contained inside one silhouette stays readable.
Complementary teal/yellow.

examples.title: Air France 'France is in the air' — Paris
examples.idea: Glamorous model framed like a postcard with red brand frame; price and city as information.
examples.composition: Photo window ~75% inside red frame; logo top; city + price bottom.
examples.typography: Bold wide sans caps; price large.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Portrait waist-up, retro styling, Eiffel tower in background.
premium: Frame colour = brand colour, repeated across series.
Hair/hat colour matched to frame red.

examples.title: Half Full — mental-health-minded beer brand
examples.idea: Optimistic/pessimistic wordplay; can split half colour / half white = 'half full'.
examples.composition: Billboard: 2-line condensed caps headline fills ~85%; small serif aside boxed at right.
examples.typography: Condensed heavy sans caps + light high-contrast serif in mixed case; ratio ~5:1.
premium: Brand name is the visual metaphor (half-filled can).
Serif/sans pairing as two voices.

examples.title: La Bâtie Festival de Genève 2026
examples.idea: Underwater/top-down photo of a person splashing; chrome-like logo on a diagonal.
examples.composition: Photo full-bleed; logo bottom-left diagonal ~60% width; dates top-right small.
examples.typography: Rounded display (Sature Rounded) with metallic treatment + italic sans subline.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Action photo, unusual angle, water distortion.
premium: Photo is commissioned, not stock.
Logo angle follows body movement.

examples.title: Amsterdam Museum Night
examples.idea: Four hands in historical lace cuffs shining flashlights into darkness; title revealed by the light.
examples.composition: Hands enter from corners; beams converge at centre where the title glows.
examples.typography: Bold sans title, partly lit/partly dark.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Staged studio photography with costume props.
examples.colour: ~70% dark navy/black, ~20% light beams, ~10% pink/white cuffs.
examples.metaphor: Exploring museums at night with a flashlight.
premium: Title integrated in the light — image and text are one.
Costume detail ties history to night.

examples.title: Purple Garden — spirituality app campaign
examples.idea: Repeated soft-blurred word ('repeat', 'feel it') as background texture; elegant serif message on top.
examples.composition: Poster: small serif headline top-left; photo inset bottom-right ~45%; blurred repeated word as texture.
examples.typography: Light transitional serif sentence-case ~5% height; bold rounded display blurred in background.
premium: Blurred type as texture instead of stock 'calm' imagery.
Monochrome plum palette.

examples.title: Annesley Junior School — 'Dare to Become'
examples.idea: Letters built from dotted/patterned multicolour lines on plum; same alphabet used for educational ABC poster.
examples.composition: 2-line headline fills ~80% of billboard; crest small bottom-left.
examples.typography: Custom geometric display with dotted inline treatment; multi-colour per letter.
examples.metaphor: Many colours = many possibilities for a child.
premium: Dark plum ground keeps multicolour from looking childish.
Same alphabet doubles as teaching material (ABC poster).

examples.title: 'Alte und neue Formen in Japan', Gewerbemuseum Basel 1959
examples.idea: Tatami-like black rectangles with yellow seams tilted; small flush-left type bottom.
examples.composition: Graphic occupies top 70% at slight angle; type block bottom-left ~35% width.
examples.typography: Neo-grotesk, two sizes only (title ~4% height, info ~2%), flush left, ragged right.
examples.grid: Asymmetric; text aligned to a column edge.
premium: Only two type sizes.
Two colours, perfect balance.

examples.title: 'der Film', Kunstgewerbemuseum Zürich 1960
examples.idea: Two words overlap at different greys — 'der' recedes, 'Film' advances; like film frames.
examples.composition: Words cross the full width at lower-middle; info flush left in red under.
examples.typography: Heavy grotesk lowercase/title-case ~18% height; info small red regular.
examples.grid: Text aligned to a strong left axis ~20% in.
premium: Huge empty top half.
Overlap creates depth with flat colour.

examples.title: 'architecture en france', Helmhaus Zürich 1963
examples.idea: Blue and red rectangles (French flag) split by a black arrow-like form.
examples.composition: Blue block left, red block right, black form between; text block left under blue.
examples.typography: Grotesk lowercase title, small info, flush left.
premium: Abstraction of a national symbol.
Lowercase title = understated.

examples.title: 'strawinsky fortner berg' concert poster
examples.designer: Page does not credit; commonly attributed to Josef Müller-Brockmann (Tonhalle 1955)
examples.idea: Diagonal white bars like musical rhythm on deep blue; names placed along the diagonals.
examples.composition: Bars cross the whole format; text rotated to follow; info block bottom-right.
examples.typography: Grotesk lowercase, rotated; small info flush left.
premium: One colour + white.
Text follows the composition's angle.

examples.title: 'fear' concert poster (Swiss-style)
examples.idea: Band name in giant lowercase grotesk cropped at edges; info in three small coloured columns.
examples.composition: Letters fill ~90% bleeding off right edge; info top-right.
examples.typography: Helvetica-like lowercase, gigantic; tiny info.
examples.negative_space: Counters of letters act as space.
premium: Cropping the word makes it more powerful.
Tiny colour coding for info.

examples.title: Katholino kindergartens — flexible identity
examples.idea: Chunky friendly display type, big simple silhouettes (rabbit, butterfly, apple), bright flat colours; each kindergarten can adapt.
examples.composition: Cards/flyers: one silhouette or one headline dominates (~60%), small info block.
examples.typography: Rounded heavy display with quirky alternates; mixed-case German headlines; simple sans for info.
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Warm real kids/teacher photos used sparingly.
examples.colour: Green, purple, pink, yellow, cyan — each piece ~2–3 colours.
premium: Flat silhouettes instead of clip-art.
Consistent display face makes varied colours feel like one family.

examples.title: St Paul's C of E Primary School — 'Life full'
examples.idea: Organic flower/leaf shapes in bold colours; simple sans wordmark; shapes cut by the frame.
examples.composition: Shape fills ~70% of card; two-line text top and bottom.
examples.typography: Rounded geometric sans, mixed-case, medium weight.
examples.colour: Orange-red, yellow, cyan, blue, magenta on sand — each card ~3 colours.
premium: Sand neutral grounds the bright palette.
Shapes cropped by edges feel alive.

examples.title: LearningWell — brand book and applications
examples.idea: Soft multi-colour gradients as 'change' metaphor; humanist serif wordmark; editorial web layout.
examples.composition: Brand book pages: gradient panel + white text panel; generous whitespace.
examples.typography: Serif wordmark + grotesk (Monument Grotesk) for UI/text.
premium: Gradients are grainy/soft, not default linear.
Serif adds warmth to an institutional brand.

examples.title: All Right? — mental health service identity
examples.idea: Question mark as tone: 'All right?' — friendly check-in; deep blue + cyan.
examples.composition: Product shots: binder/boxes with small angled type on corners.
examples.typography: Condensed bold sans (Mindset) with angled baseline; large point sizes shown 140/119pt.
premium: Tone of voice in the name drives the identity.
Two-colour restraint for a sensitive topic.

examples.title: Super Genius Society — education system identity
examples.idea: Wordmark letters overlapping playfully; acid green ground; music/learning materials as collectable cards.
examples.composition: Wordmark centred; hand prop enters from top.
examples.typography: Wide sans caps with overlapping letters.
premium: One acid colour owns the brand.
Tactile props make it human.

examples.title: Levrant — heritage architecture
examples.idea: Oxblood book covers with a small photo window and vertical spaced caps wordmark.
examples.composition: Covers: small photo ~25% centred; wordmark vertical along spine.
examples.typography: Light wide serif/sans caps with generous tracking (~+150).
premium: Small photo on big colour field = luxury.
Wide tracking on caps.

examples.title: Little Sutton Bakehouse
examples.idea: Heavy 'ink-trap' display wordmark centred over moody close-up food photography with flour dust.
examples.composition: Wordmark centred ~60% width; photo full-bleed, croissants bottom third.
examples.typography: Brûle (heavy display serif with ink traps) + Bossa wide tracked caps for 'BAKEHOUSE' (~+200).
examples.photo_scale_cropping: Low-light, shallow depth of field, motion of flour.
examples.colour: ~70% dark warm browns, ~20% golden bread, ~10% cream type.
premium: Logo placed in the dark zone of the photo for contrast.
Tracked caps descriptor as quiet second voice.
